fact: The National Council for Persons with Disabilities and IDI Uganda, with KOICA funding, set up an ICT hub in Kasese that will provide computer literacy and vocational digital training to persons with disabilities and the wider community.

The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance, with MTN Foundation Uganda and Centenary Technology Services, is implementing a Shs4 billion, three-year programme of four regional digital innovation hubs at public universities plus the Nakawa hub, expected to give over 20,000 students and community members digital skills training; the second hub was handed over at Busitema University.
